text: The Blakers-Massey theorem concerns the connectivity of the map from the homotopy pushout:
choices: it measures the Euler characteristic of pushouts
for A∪_C B with C→A m-connected and C→B n-connected, the map C→A×_B^h is (m+n)-connected
it requires A and B to be spheres
it only applies to pairs of homotopy groups
explanation: Blakers-Massey: the comparison map from C into the homotopy pullback A×_B^h B is (m+n)-connected when f:C→A is m-connected and g:C→B is n-connected. This generalises Freudenthal.
